normativeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für ein System, über dessen Grenze keine Energie übertragen wird, die Energieerhaltung formulieren und einfache Umwandlungen zwischen Energieformen bilanziell beschreiben.
normativeGoal.exactShortQuote: Anwenden des Gesetzes von der Erhaltung der Energie auf Beispiele aus der Mechanik
normativeGoal.sourceInterpretation: The binding left column requires using energy forms for transformations/transfers, applying conservation in mechanics, validity conditions, potential energy Epot=FGh and power E/t. The remarks explicitly support balances. The concrete atom asks only to formulate conservation for an energy-isolated system and balance simple transformations; it does not demand a derivation of work, kinetics or momentum dynamics.

understandingProfile.boundaryReasoning: Specifying the system and checking that no energy crosses its boundary is a precise operationalization of the printed transfer/transformation distinction and validity condition, not a claim that vector work or momentum were taught inJ7.
understandingProfile.conservationLimit: The profile does not require entropy, Carnot, differential equations or a force derivation to say that one energy balance alone does not predict direction or time. The printed J7 power relation also separates equal energy from how quickly it is transferred.
understandingProfile.caseLimit: The retained bouncing-ball and ramp case briefs use richer examples. Their exact measured-speed treatment and all illustrative numbers must not be silently substituted for the normative simple goal, nor may required P expectations be deleted to fit a task. No replacement profile or assessment is authored here.
